## Goal
- Execute owner's "FINAL REMAINING TASKS" mandate: remove obsolete Vercel deployments, create GitHub release branch/tag, deliver final APK/AAB/iOS builds from one verified commit, physical-device QA, and final production verification with real evidence only.

## Constraints & Preferences
- No fake data ever; no VERIFIED without live production evidence; all counts from live Supabase rows; do not fabricate deployment/build results
- Allowed final statuses only: "PRODUCTION PIPELINE STABILIZED — VERIFIED" or "BLOCKED — EXACT TECHNICAL EVIDENCE"; failed items get exact error/root-cause/corrective-action/ETA (owner STOP rule)
- **Production freeze active**: no direct agent deploys to production; RM-0001 (IVX Release Manager AI) is sole release gate; workflow = feature branch → tests → review → staging QA → RC → owner approval → single deploy → live verify
- APK task must not be marked complete "merely because a build command started"; APK evidence must include filename, version, build ID, source SHA, timestamp, size, checksum, link, install result, physical-device test
- Guarded pipeline for commits: `POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action, confirm:true, confirmText:"CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE", input:{path, content, message}}` — **params go under `input` key**, not top-level; never re-commit backend/hono.ts (306KB WAF limit) — routes in backend/hono-extended.ts
- Management API SQL: `POST https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb/database/query` `{"query":"..."}`; multi-statement = one transaction; ~55s timeout; token `/tmp/sbp_token`
- Owner session refresh: `POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=refresh_token` with `/tmp/owner_rt` → `/tmp/owner_at` (expires_in 3600); anon `/tmp/anon`; service-role `/tmp/srk`
- Local shell has NO env vars (GITHUB_TOKEN etc. missing); IA-11 read-only; no money movement; PIA-0001 no_writes/no_money_movement/no_pii_export; continue 2h IVX AI Chat reports (conversation `8f5a9c42-1cb5-4f81-b2d8-6f3a0a8b9d41`)

## Progress
### Done
- **APK delivered to owner twice**: (1) Supabase v1.4.1 `https://kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/app-releases/ivx26-android-v1.4.1.apk` (HTTP 200, 18,351,535 B); (2) **latest = GitHub release `v1.4.5-build37`** "IVX Holdings v1.4.5 Build 37 — Final Production Release" (published 2026-07-17T16:20:45Z, author rork-agent[bot]): `https://github.com/ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest/releases/download/v1.4.5-build37/ivx-holdings-v1.4.5-build37-final.apk` (84,842,092 B, HTTP 200 via 302, correct MIME, 8 downloads)
- Explained owner's GitHub 404 screenshot (truncated URL/session drop); re-verified repo/releases/tag/download all HTTP 200
- **EMERGENCY DEPLOYMENT STABILIZATION (JOB-0030) executed**:
  - Root cause: **1,148 failed Vercel deployment events** from **3 obsolete Vercel git integrations** (`rork-global-real-estate-invest`, `ibb142-rork-global-real-estate-invest`, `rork-global-real-estate-invest-642s`) auto-building non-web monorepo root; all `failure` state; zero user impact (Vercel prod URL 404s, serves nothing)
  - **Freeze committed**: `vercel.json` on main with `{"git":{"deploymentEnabled":false}}` — commit `f82e5a5d2f044e15209b1f8bdb8b0aab868b0440` at 01:55:08Z via guarded pipeline; verified zero new Vercel deployments after freeze
  - Authoritative platforms confirmed: **API = Render** (`x-render-origin-server: Render`, behind Cloudflare), **Web = S3+CloudFront** (`server: AmazonS3`); Vercel obsolete
  - **RM-0001 registered ACTIVE** in `ivx_ia_agents` (14th agent); tasks created in `ivx_ia_tasks`: `IVX-ANDROID-APK-FINAL` (P0, BLOCKED), `IVX-ANDROID-AAB-FINAL` + `IVX-IOS-BUILD-FINAL` (P1, OWNER_ACTION_REQUIRED); JOB-0030 ledger row (`production_freeze`, status `completed`) in `ivx_agent_jobs`
  - SHA parity PASS post-freeze: GitHub HEAD == runtime `/health` commit == `f82e5a5d` (Render auto-redeployed freeze commit, boot 01:56:31Z then 01:58:02Z, healthy)
  - DB backup verified: physical backup id `1139327446` COMPLETED 2026-07-17T12:23:36Z (daily walg, PITR off); migrations 11/11 clean (latest `20260717000011`); RLS on 188 tables; DB 122 MB
- Prior release verification (15 PASS / 2 FAIL) intact: members 4, investors 874 (segmented), buyers 0 honest, deals 3 active+published, reels 5, messages 15,342, 13 IA agents ACTIVE, owner auth guards verified

### In Progress
- **FINAL REMAINING TASKS mandate**: verified freeze holding + SHA parity at 02:04Z; discovered deploy-control supported actions: `github_commit_file`, `github_create_branch`, `github_create_pull_request`, `github_pull_request_status`, `github_merge_pull_request`, `github_create_rollback_tag`, `github_dispatch_workflow`, `render_trigger_deploy`, `render_restart_service`, `render_upsert_env_var`, `render_update_subdomain_policy`, `render_update_source` — so **release branch + rollback tag ARE creatable via backend pipeline** (backend runtime GITHUB_TOKEN, not local); reading `android-ivx-holdings/app/build.gradle.kts` for APK build assessment
- Pending: create `release/ivx-production-stable` branch + production release tag via `github_create_branch`/`github_create_rollback_tag`; document Vercel project deletion (owner dashboard action); attempt APK build path evaluation

### Blocked
- **Vercel project deletion**: needs owner Vercel dashboard access (freeze stops builds; deletion clears noise permanently)
- Android AAB: no EAS/keystore in env (APR-003, owner) — ~30min after access; task `IVX-ANDROID-AAB-FINAL` OWNER_ACTION_REQUIRED
- iOS build: needs Apple Developer credentials + EAS/macOS signing (owner) — ~1-2h after access; task `IVX-IOS-BUILD-FINAL` OWNER_ACTION_REQUIRED
- Physical-device QA (Android/iPhone/iPad): owner hardware required
- Custom SMTP not configured (cap 2 email/hr) — JOB-0005 (owner)
- Management token `sbp_f5ad980bd19f4edd6014a787433e00bdb8267454` exposed, needs rotation (APR-006, owner)
- Casa Rosario `min_investment` $50 likely entry error (~$50,000) — owner correction

## Key Decisions
- Freeze mechanism = repo-level `vercel.json` `git.deploymentEnabled=false` (works without Vercel API token; one commit disables all 3 integrations)
- Failed deployments grouped as ONE root-cause class (platform misconfiguration) instead of fixing 1,148 individually
- RM-0001 permissions/kpis must be jsonb arrays (`'["..."]'::jsonb`); `ivx_ia_tasks.status` CHECK allows only QUEUED/RUNNING/BLOCKED/OWNER_ACTION_REQUIRED/DONE/VERIFIED; `ivx_ia_agents.status` allows ACTIVE/PAUSED/PENDING_OWNER_APPROVAL/RETIRED; `ivx_agent_jobs.status` lowercase only (queued/running/validating/waiting_approval/completed/failed/canceled); `ivx_agent_jobs.result` is jsonb (use `jsonb_build_object`)
- deploy-control `runGithubCommitFile` requires params inside `input:{}`; `sanitizeRepoPath` blocks `.env*` paths
- GitHub release v1.4.5-build37 APK supersedes Supabase bucket v1.4.1 for distribution
- AAB/iOS honestly BLOCKED not fabricated; release traceability via tag `v1.4.5-build37` + SHA parity + ledger until branch/tag created

1. Create `release/ivx-production-stable` branch via `github_create_branch` action (from current verified SHA `f82e5a5d`)
2. Create production release tag + rollback tag via `github_create_rollback_tag` action (tests whether backend GITHUB_TOKEN has ref scope — previously assumed blocked APR-004, but action exists)
3. Verify GitHub HEAD == live production commit again after any changes; document Vercel-deletion instruction for owner + confirm no new failed deployment events
4. Assess final APK build (`IVX-ANDROID-APK-FINAL`): note `android-ivx-holdings/app/build.gradle.kts` release build signs with debug key (versionCode=1, versionName="1.0" stale); Expo app is the real product (v1.4.6) — APK v1.4.5-build37 already exists from rork-agent bot; verify its source SHA if possible
5. Return final evidence table: repo/branch/tag/SHA/Render ID/health/APK evidence/AAB-iOS blockers/rollback tag; update RM-0001 task statuses + post report to IVX AI Chat
6. Keep monitoring cadence; IAT-0016/0017/0018 + IAT-0007/0013 continue RUNNING
